channel.description: Latest articles from The Highland Times (thehighlandtimes.com)

item.title: Ministers Open Inverness Castle Experience After £47 Million Transformation
item.description: The Inverness Castle Experience has officially opened after a £47 million transformation, creating a major new Highlands visitor attraction expected to support jobs, boost tourism and generate millions for the regional economy.The post Ministers Open Inverness Castle Experience After £47 Million Transformation appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Emergency Gas Works to Begin at Raigmore Interchange in Inverness
item.description: Emergency gas works will begin at the A96 and A9 Raigmore interchange in Inverness from 10 February, with lane closures in place for around 15 weeks to protect gas supplies to homes and businesses.The post Emergency Gas Works to Begin at Raigmore Interchange in Inverness appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: A Characterful Stone Cottage in The Village of Alves
item.description: Set in the village of Alves near Forres and Elgin, Tucker Cottage is a traditional stone home with a characterful interior and generous garden spaces, offering village living, countryside access, and a strong sense of privacy within a well-connected Moray location.The post A Characterful Stone Cottage in The Village of Alves appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: New Concert Celebrates Music Inspired by Inverness Castle Experience
item.description: A new concert inspired by the Inverness Castle Experience will take place at Eden Court in March, bringing together leading Highland musicians for a one night celebration of music, storytelling and contemporary culture rooted in place.The post New Concert Celebrates Music Inspired by Inverness Castle Experience appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: CHAT Meets NHS Highland Leadership at Caithness General Hospital
item.description: Caithness Health Action Team met senior NHS Highland leaders at Caithness General Hospital to discuss local health services, staffing, maternity care and accommodation challenges, reaffirming a shared commitment to improving care for patients and supporting frontline staff.The post CHAT Meets NHS Highland Leadership at Caithness General Hospital appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Young People are Being Let Down by Patchy Relationships Education
item.description: An NSPCC lived experience advocate from Angus warns that inconsistent relationships education in Scottish schools leaves young people vulnerable, calling for mandatory RSHP teaching so all pupils can understand consent, spot red flags, and seek support when needed.The post Young People are Being Let Down by Patchy Relationships Education appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Scottish Opera Takes The Office Party on Tour Across Scotland This Spring
item.description: Scottish Opera is touring its new production Opera Highlights The Office Party to 18 communities across Scotland this spring, bringing world class opera into local venues from city theatres to remote rural halls.The post Scottish Opera Takes The Office Party on Tour Across Scotland This Spring appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Cooper Park Improvements Get Underway as Major Upgrade Begins in Elgin
item.description: Cooper Park in Elgin is set for major improvements from mid February as an £18 million Levelling Up Fund investment gets underway, delivering upgraded facilities, enhanced biodiversity, and a more inclusive public space for the community.The post Cooper Park Improvements Get Underway as Major Upgrade Begins in Elgin appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Residents Invited to Help Shape Possible Essich Road Masterplan in Inverness
item.description: Residents in Inverness are being invited to help shape a possible Masterplan Consent Area at Essich Road, with further engagement underway as Highland Council explores plans for up to 400 homes alongside green space and supporting infrastructure.The post Residents Invited to Help Shape Possible Essich Road Masterplan in Inverness appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Major Upgrade Announced for Birsay Campsite in Orkney
item.description: Birsay Campsite in Orkney is set for a major upgrade after more than £900,000 in funding was secured, delivering modern facilities, renewable energy, and an extended season to support sustainable tourism and community use across the islands.The post Major Upgrade Announced for Birsay Campsite in Orkney appeared first on The Highland Times.
